fields.help: 6-field cron: seconds minutes hours day month weekday. e.g. '0 0 9 * * 1-5' = weekdays at 9am.
fields.label: Cron Expression

fields.help: allow: every tick starts a run. skip: drop the tick while a run of this workflow is queued, running or waiting. queue_one: keep at most one tick waiting for the current run to end.
fields.label: When a run is still going

fields.help: What the daemon does on startup with ticks missed while it was not running (counted from the last scheduled run). none: skip them. one: a single run. all: one run per missed tick (at most 100).
fields.label: Missed runs

fields.help: Only catch up ticks missed within this long before startup (a duration such as 30m or 6h). Empty: no limit.
fields.label: Catch-up window

outputs.description: true on a catch-up run for a missed tick (absent otherwise)
